title: Local block normal form of a constant rank map
statement: Let $Y$ be a reduced scheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme], let $j:Z\to Y$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $M,N$ be sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with chosen isomorphisms $M\simeq\mathcal O_Y^m$, $N\simeq\mathcal O_Y^n$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let $\varphi:M\to N$ and $a\in\mathbb N$. Assume that for every $z\in Z$ there exist a field $K$ and $g:\operatorname{Spec}K\to Y$ with image exactly $\{j(z)\}$ such that the matrix of $\varphi$ in the chosen bases, evaluated along $g$, has rank $a$ [def-weil-matrix-rank]. Set $\psi=j^*\varphi$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. For every $z\in Z$ there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $z$, an isomorphism $e_S:(j^*M)|_U\simeq\mathcal O_U^{m-a}\oplus\mathcal O_U^a$, and an isomorphism $e_T:(j^*N)|_U\simeq\mathcal O_U^a\oplus\mathcal O_U^{n-a}$, such that $\psi|_U=e_T^{-1}\circ\mathrm{inl}\circ\mathrm{snd}\circ e_S$. Here restriction is [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], snd is projection onto the second direct summand of the source, and inl is inclusion into the first direct summand of the target.

source.place: normal-form claim and local kernel/image splitting

proof.text: Restrict to affine opens in Z. Open pullback is restriction [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction], so the given source and target bases restrict. The rings of sections on Z are reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. A field-valued point with image j(z) induces an extension of the residue field at z. Rank is invariant under this extension [lem-weil-matrix-rank-field-extension], so every residue-field matrix has rank a.

All (a+1)-minors vanish modulo every prime. The intersection of the primes is the nilradical [lem-weil-pbc-zero-locus-eq-iff-radical-eq], so these minors vanish over the reduced affine ring. At each point a nonzero a-minor exists by the rank-minor criterion [def-weil-matrix-rank]. Invert this minor; for a=0 use the empty determinant 1. Permute rows and columns and perform invertible block row and column operations to get diag(I_a,S). Each entry of the Schur complement S is, up to sign, an (a+1)-minor divided by the invertible a-minor; hence S=0.

Order the zero source coordinates first and the a pivot source coordinates last, and order the a pivot target coordinates first. The block row and column operations of the preceding step yield isomorphisms to these decompositions into free sheaves [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. In these coordinates the matrix sends (v,w) to (w,0), which is precisely inl composed with snd. Transport through the restricted given bases [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction]. If Z is empty the assertion is vacuous; rank zero uses the empty unit minor and the zero matrix.

proof_origin.place: Proof (3), normal-form claim; existing lem-pc-constant-rank-map-kernel-image proof steps 1 and 2

A constant rank matrix over a reduced ring is locally equivalent to a block identity matrix and its kernel and image are locally free

The last theorem requires a square matrix over a field; not this reduced-ring, rectangular local statement.

from.place: Proof (3): over a reduced base a map of finite free modules of locally constant fibre rank has locally the normal form diag(I,0)

lean.statement:
theorem exists_local_normal_form_of_constantRank
    {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {M N : Y.Modules} {m n : ℕ}
    (eM : M ≅ free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)))
    (eN : N ≅ free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))
    (φ : M ⟶ N) (j : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] (a : ℕ)
    (hrank : ∀ z : Z, ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsField R) (g : Spec R ⟶ Y),
      Set.range g.base = {j.base z} ∧
      ((freeMatrix (eM.inv ≫ φ ≫ eN.hom)).map g.appTop).rank = a) :
    ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Z.Opens, z ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (eS : ((Modules.pullback j).obj M).restrict U.ι ≅
          free (ULift.{u} (Fin (m - a))) ⊞ free (ULift.{u} (Fin a)))
        (eT : ((Modules.pullback j).obj N).restrict U.ι ≅
          free (ULift.{u} (Fin a)) ⊞ free (ULift.{u} (Fin (n - a)))),
        (restrictFunctor U.ι).map ((Modules.pullback j).map φ) =
          eS.hom ≫ biprod.snd ≫ biprod.inl ≫ eT.inv
